title: Wulli Wulli dialect - Wikipedia
text: Wuliwuli (also Wuli Wuli, Wulli Wulli) is an extinct Australian Aboriginal language of the Pama-Nyungan language family formerly spoken by the Wulli Wulli people in Queensland, Australia. [1] Wuliwuli is regarded as a dialect of Wakka Wakka. [2][3]
